prompt:
Create a cute premium 3D brand mascot for ClawX / Verse Claw in the style of a modern Chinese brand IP presentation. Soft vinyl toy, smooth clay render, rounded simple shapes, warm and playful.

Mascot: a small round yellow AI companion named Clawling. It has a red-orange soft hood shaped like three rounded claw/flame petals, clearly related to ClawX but cute and simple. Yellow chubby body, cream-white belly patch shaped like a tiny claw print, tiny black oval eyes, small rounded side arms, short red-orange feet.

Composition: centered mascot on a clean warm orange rounded card background, generous padding, polished brand mascot presentation, no readable text.

Materials: matte soft vinyl, gentle studio lighting, rounded bevels, low detail and high recognition.

Avoid: mushroom cap, mecha, metal, sharp armor, crab, lobster, realistic animal, busy background, text, letters, watermark.
